body:
Part of #2525 (slice 6 of 6). The maintainer set the priority on 2026-11-18: "GPU shader issues get priority".

Depends on #2613 (CPU raster search). Relates to #2164 (remnant sheets), #2404 (vacuum zones), #2406 (remnant library) and #2398 (grain).

## What to add

In the raster evaluator of `camcraft-geometry`:

- **Remnant sheet.** An irregular sheet boundary, with holes, rasterises in the under-approximate mode of #2612. Cells outside the boundary are occupied.
- **Keep-out zones.** A clamp or a keep-out region rasterises as occupied cells (over-approximate).
- **Vacuum-zone weight.** A second integer layer gives each cell a weight. The search prefers positions where small parts sit on live zones. The weight changes the order of candidates only. It never makes an occupied cell free. The tie-break stays the packed key of #2613.
- **Grain (#2398).** Grain filters the rotation set before the search. No raster change. When #2398 has a rotation filter, use it.
- The exact vector check of #2613 also tests each part against the remnant boundary and the keep-out regions.
- If #2615 (GPU) exists, extend its kernel with the same layers and keep the parity test green. If not, the CPU reference is enough for this issue.

## Notes

- Changes nest positions: under the safety floor, `effort:high`.
- No new crate edge and no new dependency.
- No new MCP tool here. The nest commands and their MCP tools are #2160 and #2164. Say in the PR which fields those tools must pass.

## Done means

Tests in `crates/geometry/tests/` show:
- Parts nest inside an L-shaped remnant with a hole and stay out of the hole, checked by `Region` booleans.
- Parts stay out of two keep-out zones.
- With a vacuum weight layer, the smallest part sits on a live zone where a legal position exists there.
- The same input gives the same layout on each run.
